beats.speaker: guide
beats.line: Welcome to the Stone Age! Eleven thousand years ago, the ice is melting, and the world is wild.
beats.scene: Wide prehistoric valley: mountains with snow caps, hills, trees, a far-off mammoth, birds. The monkey guide walks in from the left, stops centre and waves.
beats.camera: slow pan right, then gentle push in as he stops

beats.speaker: guide
beats.line: By day, people gather berries and roots. Then they strike stone on stone, and chip off a sharp blade!
beats.scene: Camp edge in daylight. A woman picks red berries into a basket; a man kneels and knaps flint, flakes fly. The guide copies the strike with his own stone, then holds up a blade.
beats.camera: pan from the gatherer to the toolmaker, push in on the strike

beats.speaker: guide
beats.line: At night, the family gathers by the fire, to cook, share stories, and stay warm and safe.
beats.scene: Night, stars, a moon. Four people sit around a crackling campfire; one roasts food on a stick, one tells a story with big gestures, a child leans in. The guide sits on a log at the right and points to the fire.
beats.camera: slow push in towards the fire
